config.enable-duck-dual-drop.name: Enable Duck Dual Drop
config.enable-duck-dual-drop.tooltip: When a high-friendship duck produces a Duck Feather, it also drops its regular Duck Egg, eliminating the feather revenue loss.
config.duck-dual-drop-min-hearts.name: Dual Drop Min Hearts
config.duck-dual-drop-min-hearts.tooltip: Minimum friendship hearts required before a duck can drop both an egg and feather together (default: 4 hearts).
config.duck-dual-drop-chance.name: Dual Drop Chance
config.duck-dual-drop-chance.tooltip: Probability of dropping an egg alongside a feather at 5 friendship hearts (default: 1.0 = 100% guarantee).
config.enable-duck-feather-loom.name: Enable Loom Down Cloth
config.enable-duck-feather-loom.tooltip: Allows Duck Feathers to be processed in the Loom into luxury Down Cloth.
Reduces rabbit harvest cooldown from 4 days to 2 days (matching ducks and goats).
config.rabbit-days-to-produce.name: Rabbit Days To Produce
config.rabbit-days-to-produce.tooltip: Number of days required between rabbit produce drops (default: 2).
config.enable-rabbit-multi-drop.name: Enable Rabbit Multi-Drop
config.enable-rabbit-multi-drop.tooltip: Grants high-friendship rabbits (3+ hearts) a chance to produce bonus wool or lucky feet.
config.rabbit-multi-drop-chance.name: Multi-Drop Chance
config.rabbit-multi-drop-chance.tooltip: Probability of bonus produce for high-friendship rabbits (default: 0.35 = 35%).
config.enable-rabbit-foot-rebalance.name: Rebalance Rabbit's Foot Price
config.enable-rabbit-foot-rebalance.tool: Rebalances base sell price for Rabbit's Foot in Data/Objects.
config.rabbit-foot-base-price.name: Rabbit's Foot Base Price
config.rabbit-foot-base-price.tooltip: Base sell price for Rabbit's Foot before quality and Rancher bonuses (default: 850g; 1,020g Rancher / 1,700g Iridium).
config.enable-sheep-daily-shear.name: Daily Shearing at Max Hearts
config.enable-sheep-daily-shear.tooltip: Allows sheep to be sheared every single day once they reach 5 friendship hearts.
